Defense

AC 14, touch 12; flat-footed 12 (+2 dex, +2 natural)

hp 6 [9] (1d6+3)

mp 6

Fort +2, Ref +2, Will +4

Defensive Abilities Hard Scale, Legless; Resist Water 5;

Offense

Speed 5 ft., swim 50 ft.

Melee Trident +1 (1d8+1/19-20)

Ranged Water Power Staff +2 (1d6+1 water)

Spells Known (White Mage CL 1st, Concentration +3)

At will (DC 16) - Alleviate, Daze, Guidance, Holy Orb

1st (DC 17) - Blind, Cure, Dia, Heal, Mage Armor

Statistics

Str 12, Dex 14, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 12

Base Atk +0; CMB +1; CMD 13 (cannot be tripped)

Feats Extra MP

Skills Perception +6, Spellcraft +4;

Languages Aquan, Common

SQ Amphibious, Seasinger, Spell Proficiency, Trident Expert, White Magery (Spell Mastery)

Gear cure potion (1), water power staff, trident

description.value: Merfolk are amphibious, but prefer not to spend long periods out of the water.

contextNotes.text: Can breathe both air and water.
Can breathe both air and water.

description.value: Merfolk have a +2 natural armor bonus.

contextNotes.text: The +2 natural armor is already included.

description.value: Merfolk have no legs, and therefore cannot be tripped.

contextNotes.text: Immune to trip, including in water.

description.value: The beautiful voices of the merfolk are legendary. A seasinger gains a +2 racial bonus on Perform (sing) checks and a +1 racial bonus to the save DC of charm and fascinated effect spells.

contextNotes.text: +1 DC only for charm and fascination spells; +2 to Perform (sing).

description.value: Merfolk are proficient with tridents.
